title: Agoura Hills City Council Meeting October 14, 2026

segments.text: Hello and welcome to the Agora Hills
City Council meeting of October 14th,
2026. Please silence all cell phones and
electronic devices during the live
meeting.
To prevent interference with the audio
visual system, do not join the Zoom
webinar from within the Council
Chambers. As this is a special meeting,
members of the public may only comment
on items listed on the agenda either in
person in the Council Chambers or
remotely via Zoom, which is audio only.
All speakers addressing the City Council
are to refrain from disorderly conduct
that disrupts or otherwise impedes the
orderly conduct of the meeting. I will
now defer to the City Clerk.
>> Thank you, Mayor Wolf. Individuals
wishing to speak or submit written
comments in the Council Chambers must
complete a public comment card for each
item and submit it to the City Clerk
before public comment begins. Any
written comments received by email
before today's 4:00 p.m. deadline have
been distributed to the City Council and
will be included in the record. Written
comments will not be read aloud. Remote
participants wishing to speak may use
Zoom's raise hand function. When
recognized by the City Clerk, please
unmute your microphone and provide your
comments. Participants joining by
telephone may press star nine to request
to speak and star six to unmute when
called upon by the City Clerk. Requests
to speak must be received before the
Mayor closes public comment. Remote
participants wishing to comment on
additional items must remain in or
rejoin the Zoom webinar.
Public testimony is limited to three
minutes per speaker and a speaker's time
may not be transferred. For complete
instructions and information on
accessing the meeting remotely by Zoom
or telephone, please refer to the public
participation section of the agenda.
Thank you.

So, tonight we have a very special
presentation to honor the 80th
anniversary of Scouting America's Boy
Scouts of America Troop 127.
BSA Troop 127 proudly celebrates its
80th anniversary of continuous service,
dedication, and leadership here in
Agoura Hills and the surrounding area.
Since its founding in 1946, the troop
has mentored countless young people,
mentored countless young people in the
principles of the Scout Oath and Law,
cultivating good citizenship, personal
growth, and environmental stewardship.
Troop 127 stands amongst the among the
region's longest-serving
scouting units, has produced, wow, 172
Eagle Scouts, the highest rank
attainable in scouting, and is sponsored
by the Las Virgenes Scouting Alumni
Association. Its members have
consistently demonstrated civic
responsibility through hands-on local
community service project, generous
volunteerism, and helping make our city
and our region a better place to live.
Troop 127 has traditionally led the
Reyes Adobe Days Days Parade also here
in Agoura Hills.
This remarkable 80th anniversary
reflects the enduring commitment of
dedicated Scoutmaster,
adult leaders, supportive families, and
generations of Scouts who have upheld
the highest standards of character and
accomplishment. And in honor of this
milestone,
Troop 127 welcomed family and friends to
a festive celebration at Malibu Lake
earlier in August honoring eight decades
of friendship, of growth, and of
service.
It is with great pleasure that I, as
mayor, and on behalf of our entire city
council, congratulate Scouting America's
BSA Troop 127 on the occasion of their
80th anniversary and express our deepest
gratitude for their extraordinary
service and our unwavering commitment to
our city. Thank you, guys, so much for
everything you do to make our city and
our region a better place. It is an
honor to celebrate you here tonight.
